Drake confirmed Saturday that Fear of Missing Out, the project he has been quietly teasing since August, is a film, and it arrives Tuesday, September 15 at 9 p.m. ET on YouTube.

Video:

He made it official with an Instagram caption calling it “a not so short film directed and scored by the family,” attached to a teaser that gave fans their first real look at what he has been building.

The clip runs about 25 seconds. A lime green speedboat cuts across open water with a city skyline sitting in the distance, and Drake appears to be the one behind the wheel.
